recommended_path: Fundacja (foundation) for a single foreign founder; stowarzyszenie (association) if 7+ founders are available
entity_types: Fundacja (foundation — 1 founder, foreigners allowed, no local-presence rule for the founder)
Stowarzyszenie (association — 7+ founders; legal personality only upon KRS entry)
OPP status (public-benefit organization listing in the register of OPP — separate, needs 2 years of qualifying activity)

requirements.founders: Fundacja: 1 founder (individual or legal person, foreign nationals OK). Stowarzyszenie: 7+ members (Prawo o stowarzyszeniach Art. 9)
requirements.local_presence: Local registered office (siedziba) in Poland; a virtual address suffices; no residency requirement for founders
requirements.documents: Fundacja: notarized deed of foundation (statut) + application on KRS-W20 and KRS-WK forms. Stowarzyszenie: statutes + founding members' list, filed in paper or electronic form

forms: KRS-W20 (fundacja: basic registration form) + KRS-WK (officers: zarząd and organ nadzoru)
Notarized deed (akt założycielski) for the fundacja — notary cost is the dominant setup cost
Stowarzyszenie: statutes + 7 founders' names, filed at the KRS court (paper or via Portal Rejestrów Sądowych prs.ms.gov.pl)

fees.source: Art. 53 ust. 1 ustawy o kosztach sądowych (via https://lexlege.pl and poradnik.ngo.pl)
fees.note: The 250 PLN is the fundacja/general KRS fee — NOT the stowarzyszenie fee

fees.source: Art. 17 ust. 3 Prawa o stowarzyszeniach (consolidated text at api.sejm.gov.pl), in force since 20 May 2016
fees.note: Supersedes any prior figure implying a court fee for stowarzyszenia; only notarization of founding documents may add cost if desired

fees.amount: ~500-1,500 PLN (notary tariff depends on statute length and number of founders)
fees.source: https://poradnik.ngo.pl/rejestracja-fundacji-formularze-dokumenty (guide) + Polish notary fee schedule (ustawa o opłacie za czynności notarialne: fee per statute up to 10 pages max ~1,100-1,400 PLN + 23% VAT)
fees.note: The statutory notary tariff is primary law; the 500-1,500 PLN range is the practical market range

timelines.fundacja: 2-4 weeks (notary appointment + KRS statutory term ~30 days; in practice 2-8 weeks)
timelines.stowarzyszenie: 4-8 weeks (KRS court processing; statutory 30-day term, legal personality arises on entry per Art. 17)

supersedes: Prior v2 '~500-1,500 PLN notary + small fees' refined: KRS court fee is 250 PLN for fundacja only; stowarzyszenie is court-fee-free (Art. 17 ust. 3, since 20.05.2016)
sources: https://lexlege.pl (Art. 53 ustawy o kosztach sądowych — 250 PLN)
https://api.sejm.gov.pl (consolidated Prawo o stowarzyszeniach — Art. 9, Art. 17 ust. 3)
